title: Why the Mercedes-AMG One Took Years Longer Than Promised
description:
In twenty seventeen, Mercedes-AMG promised a Formula One car for the road, and said it would arrive in twenty nineteen. It arrived in January twenty twenty-three. And when it did, several numbers that were promised in the early reports had changed. The weight, the gearbox, the acceleration. This is the story of why the Mercedes-AMG One took years longer than promised, and what changed on the way. Here is the twist. The company itself never hid the delay. Its boss said there was no excuse on the company's side. Its chief executive joked that they must have been drunk when they said yes. And the delay was not caused by one problem. It was caused by at least four, and one of them was a number so small it fits in a sentence. Twelve hundred.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
